canonical_name: Global Langlands correspondence for function fields
canonical_statement: Provisional source reading: for a global function field over a finite field and an integer n >= 1, irreducible rank-n l-adic representations of its absolute Galois group with finite-order determinant correspond to cuspidal automorphic representations of GL_n over its adele ring with finite-order central character, compatibly with unramified Frobenius and Satake data.
scope_ambiguity: The repository label does not choose Drinfeld GL_2 versus Laurent Lafforgue GL_n, nor a direction, coefficient field, equivalence relation, ramification convention, or normalization. The provisional reading is not an exact frozen theorem.
domain_and_universes: Expected: finite constant field k, global function field F/k, n : Nat with n >= 1, coefficient prime ell distinct from char(k), and an algebraic closure of Q_ell; exact universes and Lean object models remain open.
ordered_binders: F : global function field over k
hypotheses: Galois-side objects are continuous irreducible rank-n l-adic representations
automorphic-side objects are cuspidal representations of GL_n over the adeles of F
conclusion: A bijective correspondence preserving unramified local Frobenius/Satake characteristic-polynomial data; the exact normalization is not yet frozen.
degenerate_and_boundary_cases: n = 1 is included in the provisional GL_n reading and should recover global class field theory. n = 0 is excluded. GL_2/Drinfeld is a historical subcase, not a substitute for GL_n if the Lafforgue reading is accepted.
